caption: A ripe avocado is pressed firmly between finger and thumb and the skin dents inward and stays dented.

sa.check: An avocado is held between finger and thumb.
The dent stays after the fingers lift.
The press comes first, then the dent, then the fingers lift.

pc.expect: The dent forms under the fingers; the avocado does not spring back like a ball or crack like a shell.
pc.fail: It springs back; or the skin cracks open; or it does not dent.

pc.expect: The dent remains after the fingers lift.
pc.fail: It fills back in; or it is present before the press; or it deepens after the fingers have gone.

pc.expect: The fruit stays in the hand.
pc.fail: It drops; or jumps; or moves before the press.

pc.expect: The dents are where the finger and thumb pressed.
pc.fail: Dents appear elsewhere; or the press leaves no dent; or the whole fruit collapses.

pc.expect: One avocado keeps its number, and the fingers do not pass through it.
pc.fail: The fruit splits; or the fingers pass through it; or a second avocado appears.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The avocado's colour and the background stay the same.
pc.fail: The skin changes colour; or the hand changes; or the background rearranges.
